cc:Work.dc:title: Smart Casino Floor 2.0 architecture
cc:Work.dc:description: Operational observations through Kafka and RisingWave, manager-reviewed command delivery, separate player analytics, and optional LLM providers.

g.text: Implemented demo architecture · Streaming observations and one-click approved actions
Reviewed command delivery · simulator polls /commands every ~1s
Templates + manual form without a key
Analytics SELECT queries · application-managed chat memory
Freshness + version + staff + conflict checks · Unique command IDs · +5 / +15 minute observations
One action per scenario. Forecasts use demo assumptions; observed changes are not causal revenue lift.
